hooks.name: Kiro pointer guard
hooks.description: Warns when a .kiro/ pointer skill or agent is edited directly, since the authoritative source lives in .claude/ (see .kiro/steering/kiro-powers.md, "The one rule").

action.command: f=$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"\(file_path\|path\|filePath\)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\2/p' | head -n1); case "$f" in *.kiro/skills/*|*.kiro/agents/*) rel=${f##*.kiro/}; src=".claude/${rel%/SKILL.md}"; case "$f" in *SKILL.md) src=".claude/skills/$(basename "$(dirname "$f")")/SKILL.md";; *agents/*.json) src=".claude/agents/$(basename "${f%.json}").md";; esac; echo "WARNING: $f is a Kiro pointer, not the source of truth. Per .kiro/steering/kiro-powers.md (\"The one rule\"), edit the authoritative file in .claude/ instead: $src . The pointer only names and summarises its .claude/ counterpart." >&2;; esac; exit 0
